changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionResponsibilityRule') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionResponsibilityRule]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](255) NULL, [IsVisible] [bit] NULL, [ApplyToType] [bit] NULL, [Context] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Definition] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [DefinitionConverted] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Action] [nvarchar](10) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionResponsibilityRules] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] TEXTIMAGE_ON [PRIMARY] END
